subject.title: Feature: Default outbound topic/thread binding per agent for Telegram

question: Should Telegram add a config-level per-agent outbound topic default, or should explicit topic targets plus active-context auto-threading remain the intended boundary?
rationale: The requested behavior adds a new Telegram config/default surface and changes visible delivery precedence for proactive sends in forum groups, which needs maintainer product intent before implementation.

options.title: Add outbound topic defaults
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned outbound default with explicit threadId and topic-qualified targets taking precedence, plus docs and regression coverage for proactive message.send.

options.title: Keep current boundary
options.body: Leave routing to explicit :topic: targets, per-call threadId, and active-context inheritance, then document the expected proactive-send contract more clearly.

options.title: Prefer fail/warn behavior
options.body: Do not add a new default yet; instead make ambiguous proactive sends to forum groups fail or warn when no topic can be resolved.

recommendation.title: Add outbound topic defaults
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned outbound default with explicit threadId and topic-qualified targets taking precedence, plus docs and regression coverage for proactive message.send.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is closest to the current action-threading and adjacent topic-send routing work he recently touched.
